action: preserved results of actual local rule-library execution
sharing_scope: Public repository: only purpose-written synthetic fixtures and their outputs; no internal source data, real customer rows, credentials or runtime binaries.
code_adaptation: Published runner reads fixed fixtures and creates a new results folder; original measurements and result files are preserved.
license_notice: Third-party ko-pii code is MIT. This does not assign a license to other project material.
limitations: Hand-authored small synthetic set, repeated values, no independent holdout.
Explicit field masking is a schema assertion, not automatic detector accuracy.
Six-column residual count excludes custom policy IDs and free-text notes.
No operational MAPS migration or API integration verification.
publication_note: Repository text uses normalized LF line endings. Measurement input hashes refer to the original local test files; each rerun records its own actual input hashes.
